text:
sara-sales: Heads-up — AcmeBank POC kickoff tomorrow. They require SSO (SAML), SCIM for user sync, and RBAC that maps to AD groups. Also asked about domain ownership checks and pricing for a 2-week Dedicated pool during POC. Can SE + security confirm blockers and a quick price range?

javier-se: Which IdP are they running? Okta or ADFS? That affects SAML metadata flow and SCIM attributes.

sara-sales: They're on Okta for auth and Azure AD for some side services. They said users come from multiple verified domains (acme.com + acme-eu.com).

mike-se: Okta + multitenant domains is fine. Main items: 1) SAML metadata exchange, 2) SCIM mappings for groups -> role claim, 3) a small RBAC shim on our side to map incoming groups to Redwood roles.

alice-sec: Security notes: we need their SAML cert + entityID + ACS URL. For SCIM we require TLS + mutual auth optional but recommended. Also request completed security questionnaire (SSO section) and AIC (audit) contact. Any legal/regulatory constraints?

kevin-ps: Pricing — for a 2-week Dedicated POC with reserved GPUs, ballpark is $7k–$12k depending on model size and peak qps. If they only want a capped burst window (no 24/7), we can do a discounted short-term commit. I'll surface exact numbers after SE confirms expected concurrency and model.

javier-se: For SCIM attribute mapping, recommend mapping Okta group names to an "redwood_role" SCIM extension attribute. Example mapping:

```
scimMapping: {
  "emails[0].value": "user.email",
  "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:redwood:2.0:User": {
     "redwood_role": "groups[0]"
  }
}
```

mike-se: For RBAC: implement server-side role table: okta-group -> role id -> allowed routes. We can do soft-enforcement during POC and enable strict enforcement post-contract.

sara-sales: They asked about domain verification for provisioning. Do we require DNS TXT per domain?

sean-ops: Yes — for tenant-level domain controls we require either DNS TXT or a verification email to an admin@domain. For multi-domain customers we support multiple verified domain entries on the tenant. Note: wildcard domains are not accepted.

alice-sec: Also flag: SCIM provisioning will create service accounts on their side? Confirm least-privilege. We prefer a SCIM service account scoped to user/group provisioning only.

kevin-ps: Action items for quote: (1) concur on peak qps and model (SE), (2) confirm exact dates (sales), (3) optional mTLS for SCIM (security), (4) domain verification method (ops). I can produce a draft PO with two options once we have (1).

idp-bot: SAML metadata received from acme.okta.com at 2025-05-05T08:13:12Z — uploaded to POC workspace.

javier-se: Great — I'll validate metadata and produce a short checklist we can share with the customer's IdP admin (ACS/EntityID/Attribute statements + SCIM URL + auth token). Will drop checklist in this thread in ~30m. :thumbsup:

sara-sales: Perfect. I'll message the customer with the checklist and confirm the POC window. Thanks all.
